executionModel: Five waves on one branch and one working directory. Wave 1 (LPI-WIRE, LPI-VIM-STOP, LPI-NS-INDEX) is implemented at b327141 and runs as review-and-repair reruns (design section 11 R1-R6): deliverable check, verification rerun, mutation evidence, then independent read-only review by the workflow review step (LPI-VIM-STOP also gets test-integrity and adversarial review), repairs only for findings, acceptance recorded in each Progress Log. Wave-1 plans share target/ and editor/node_modules; fanout concurrency 1 avoids compile and test races. A compile error in a file outside a plan's writePaths is waited on (2 min, at most 3 retries) and then reported as drift, never repaired. Wave 2 (LPI-PLAYBACK) starts only after all three wave-1 plans are accepted. Wave 3 (LPI-STYLE) has an explicit dependsOn edge on LPI-PLAYBACK: their source writePaths are disjoint and LPI-STYLE uses none of LPI-PLAYBACK's content, but both rebuild editor/dist and write the e2e output roots, and native fanout starts every dependency-ready plan at once, so the edge is what serializes them. Wave 4 (LPI-BEHAVIOR, depends on LPI-PLAYBACK and LPI-STYLE) and wave 5 (LPI-CLOSEOUT) run alone. Waves 2-5 each own editor/dist and the measurement lock while running. The design and plans are committed before fanout. Workers edit only their own Progress Log and record pre/post sha256 for every edit. Heavy suites (full vitest, Playwright including test:style, full nextest) take the measurement lock at /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr-worktrees/.measure-lock. mise run build-wasm-release and VACTR_REQUIRE_SESSION_ABI=1 npm run build run immediately before any e2e or test:style run. After the final integration review, the workflow integration step archives the seven live-perf-int plans and this manifest (LPI-CLOSEOUT 'Post-review archive'). Session-441 continuation state (HEAD 9610246): the session-438 reruns of LPI-WIRE (WR1-WR3, plus a [GRAPH, 0] truncation case added to src/host/tests/contracts.rs), LPI-VIM-STOP (VR1-VR3) and LPI-NS-INDEX (NR1-NR3) and the LPI-PLAYBACK run (fresh-build e2e:examples 8/8, stale-build outcome, no source change) are committed, but no plan has an independent review verdict yet, so all seven plans remain and acceptedDependencies is empty. A rerun of an already-executed task re-verifies on the current tree and records its review verdict; it does not re-implement.

designDecisionsAndRationale: W1: renumber the live-perf control tags (0x1F/0x20) rather than the song tags, because the song tags are the earlier, test-pinned main contract; the LP-CONTRACT pre-check grep was case-sensitive and missed the lowercase song constants.

W3: one regression guard in contracts.rs (537 lines) proves tag-set disjointness instead of growing song_resource_carriers.rs (991 lines).
V1-V3: keep the platform-strict app-level handler (D10) and restore main's modifier-tolerant Vim P2 fallback with the live-perf Shift form; Mod-. is gentle stop-all and Mod-Shift-. is cut (D2).
D-a/D-b/D-c: diagnose I4 and I5 with real runs first; check defects are fixed in the check, product deviations in product code; nothing is relaxed.
I6: keep the name-space index because large-eval scaling depends on it, but only after a differential test proves results equal the old linear lookups.

S0/S1/S2: diagnose UF-1 before changing anything; always fix the glide-row inset; change the style check only for scrolled-out (unpainted) controls, never by container identity (review DR-1), with mutation evidence that same-container and cross-container painted overlaps still fail.

intentionalTradeoffs: test/canvas/vim-mount.test.ts alternate-shortcut cases change intentionally: the unshifted alternate-modifier period now means gentle stop-all per D2/D10; no assertion is removed.

Wave-1 plans are logically parallel but share target/ and editor/node_modules; fanout concurrency 1 is recommended.

Meta-. on Linux/Windows and Ctrl-. on Apple with Vim on route through the fallback exactly once; platform-Mod presses are consumed only by the app-level handler (no double send).
Mod-Shift-. with key '>' and code 'Period' passes through Vim in every mode.
With Vim off, the alternate modifier does nothing, as on main.
Vim :hush, vactr.hush and keymap presets binding vactr.hush still send hush (cut).
